2.x: 1. Wax model coated with clay. 2. Heated: the wax melts out. 3. Molten metal poured into the hollow mould. 4. Clay removed.

Lost-wax objects: the **Dancing Girl**, the **copper dog and bird of Lothal**, the **bronze bull of Kalibangan**, buffalo and goat figures; the method continued in Late Harappan and Chalcolithic cultures (Daimabad bronzes) and later in **Chola** bronzes such as the **Nataraja**.
Tools: chisels, needles, fishhooks, razors, mirrors, axes; vessels of copper, bronze and **silver**.

3.x: Terracottas are crude, used by common people as toys or cult objects; seals and metal images were for the upper class.
